{"metadata":{"description":"Condition-driven wakeup for DeepSeek Harness: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent, with dock, sidebar branch, and a global dashboard.","id":"gh:1333122965","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-sentinel","slug":"fuhefei/dsh-sentinel","topics":["dsh","dsh-better-sidebar","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Condition-driven wakeup for DeepSeek Harness: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" wake the agent, with dock, sidebar branch, and a global dashboard."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-sentinel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Condition-driven wakeup for DeepSeek Harness: the agent registers a watch, goes to sleep — even clos"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"es the session — and the sentinel wakes it when the condition happens. Every subscription and every "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"fire is a user-visible session event, and the browser dock shows what is on duty."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The node half owns one server-lifetime runtime that folds a plugin-owned sidecar log (`$DSH_HOME/sen"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"tinel.jsonl`) into live subscriptions, probes every probe sensor on a shared 5s heartbeat, observes "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"every published session's durable `turn/end` event for `session` watches, and delivers wakeups throu"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"gh the official followup channel — resuming a dormant session's agent first when needed. Subscriptio"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ns therefore survive process restarts, and conditions that become true while the server is down late"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"-fire on the next probe (session watches fire on the next observed turn end)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Watching is a resident-process concern: probing and fire delivery only run while a long-running dsh "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"process (typically `dsh web`) is up. Headless one-shot runs load the plugin and can create, list and"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" cancel watches, but nothing probes after the process exits — those watches become active once a res"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ident process starts."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"One duty owner per `$DSH_HOME`: a lease file (`sentinel.lease`) makes the first process own probing "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"and delivery; a second dsh process on the same home stays passive (tools work, writes persist to the"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" shared sidecar) and takes over within one lease TTL of the owner dying. The owner re-reads the side"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"car every heartbeat, so watches created on a passive instance are adopted automatically. Delivery is"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" at-least-once: a fire logged but not delivered before a crash is requeued on the next boot from its"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" `delivered` watermark."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The browser half is a dock card above the composer (the `conversation.input.dock` family) listing th"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e session's active watches — sensor, target, live probe state, fire budget, next-probe countdown — p"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lus recent fire history when expanded. It polls the read-only state route and renders nothing when t"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"he session has no watches."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Sensors"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Kind | Engine | Fires on |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `file` | path snapshot + inotify push | snapshot change (sub-second); accelerated by fs events |
|"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" `command` | read-only shell line, probed on an interval | output/exit-code change |
| `http` | URL "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"probed on an interval | status/body change |
| `process` | `pgrep -f` pattern, probed on an interval"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" | match-set change |
| `port` | TCP connect to `[host:]port`, probed on an interval | reachability "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"change (open/closed/timeout) |
| `webhook` | pure push | any POST to the returned hook URL |
| `sess"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ion` | host session-event feed (no probing) | another session's `turn/end`; optional `pattern` filte"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"rs the reason kind |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"With `pattern`, probe kinds fire on the no-match→match edge of that regex, webhooks accept only matc"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"hing payloads, and session watches fire only when the ended turn's reason kind matches the regex (`c"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ompleted`, `max-tokens`, `aborted`, `blocked`, `error`, `interrupted`, `forked`); without it, probe "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"kinds fire on any change after the baseline, webhooks fire on any POST, and session watches fire on "},{"id":"p14s5","text":" any change after the baseline, webhooks fire on any POST, and session watches fire on any turn end."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Session watches make serial session chains possible without poking anything from a prompt: `{ "kind""},{"id":"p15s2","text":": "session", "target": "<other-session-id>", "note": "step 1 finished — you're up", "maxFires": 1 }`"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" wakes the watching session when the target session finishes a turn, and `pattern: "^completed$"` re"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"quires a clean completion (a crashed or aborted session never satisfies it, so the chain stops). The"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" event is the host's durable `turn/end`; no probe baseline or heartbeat is involved. A turn end that"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" happens while no resident dsh process can observe events is not replayed later — use a probe-backed"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" gate when a chain must survive total downtime."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"All deployment-tunable knobs live in the plugin's config schema (defaults in parentheses); override "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"them on the bundle row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Invalid values fail plugin load with a schema error rather than misbehaving at runtime."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Verified against these harness versions (plugin loads, duty lease is held, web routes answer). Sessi"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"on watches require the host's root-scope `session/event` feed, which the supported 0.2.x line provid"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"es; on a host outside that range the watch would be accepted but never fire. Sidecar rollback note: "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"a `sentinel.jsonl` containing session-watch rows (new `kind`, or `trigger.kind: "session"` on fired "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"rows) is rejected by 0.13.2 and older readers — cancel those watches before downgrading."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- `0.2.1-rc.4` — 2026-11-02, live web deployment upgraded from `0.2.1-rc.2` together with the `v0.14"},{"id":"p23s2","text":".0` plugin (launcher backup + clean profile reinstall + automatic verify/rollback kept; rehearsed fi"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"rst on an isolated copy of the live profile): launcher `0.2.1-rc.4`, sentinel **0.14.0**, web-shell "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"`0.2.0`; boot graph 72 rows, both client bundles served, duty lease and state route answer, zero ski"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"pped bundles / activation warnings, no host `@deepseek-ai` packages in the profile. `locale: zh` is "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"configured in the profile patch for server messages. The deployment's own `check-sentinel-deploy.sh`"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" returned `RESULT: PASS`.
